newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Adolfo Dominguez starts share flotation.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Adolfo Dominguez starts share flotation.

text.p: Spanish fashion design house Adolfo Dominguez on Monday started an initial public offering of around six million shares, or 70 percent of its capital, a spokesman said.
The price will be set at between 2,650 and 3,100 pesetas per share.
Of the total offer, 39 percent will be offered to retail investors who will be given a three percent discount off the final price.
Another tranche of the offer is expected to be taken up by regional savings banks, although the exact percentage has not yet been established, the spokesman said.
The firm will give a full presentation to the stock exchange on Tuesday.
